{"parentUuid":"03524a94-40b8-48bf-a3d0-557067fa068d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"871c469d-8dd5-440e-9b1e-0b643bb2d2d3","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01E22RebNoVgysfEASddNHPY","type":"tool_result","content":"## Problem Statement\n\nASA, the African Student Association at Kenyon, is described in the client brief as a student group primarily for African students and students with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African cultures and community. Students need an easy way to find event announcements (including an Afrobeat event), learn about the association, explore cultural resources, and see photos from past activities. Its leaders need event announcements to be quick to publish, information about ASA to stay easy to find in the navigation, and a way to share photos only when ASA has permission to use them. One ASA leader should manage accounts and permanent pages; another member should be able to write and update event posts without a complicated form.\n\nThis is a class project (IPHS 400, Mini-Project #2). No claim is made about any real ASA process, officers, schedule or history. Terms below are defined in `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n## Solution\n\nA small CMS. A local admin console lets an Admin and Editors write **Posts** and **Pages**, manage accounts, and preview content. A `cms publish` step renders only **Published** content into a static public site, and `cms deploy` sends it to GitHub Pages, at which point the content is **Live**. The admin console never goes on the public internet (ADR-001).\n\nThe public site has a **Home page** (a short **Welcome text** taken from the client brief plus the five latest **Announcements**), an **Announcements** list, and **Navigation** built from published Pages (starter Pages for the demo: About ASA, Resources, Photos). Event announcements are ordinary Posts with the event's date, time, location and who can attend written in the **Body**. Photos are images inside Posts or Pages; there is no upload form.\n\n## User Stories\n\n### Signing in\n1. As an Admin, I want to sign in with a username and password, so that only authorised people can change the site.\n2. As an Editor, I want to sign in and out, so that my session ends when I leave a shared computer.\n3. As an account owner, I want my password stored hashed, so that nobody, including the Admin, can read it.\n4. As an Admin, I want a wrong password to be rejected with a clear message that does not reveal whether the username exists, so that accounts cannot be guessed.\n5. As someone with a Deactivated account, I want sign-in to be refused, so that a former member can no longer change the site.\n6. As a signed-in user, I want every form I submit to be protected against forged requests, so that another website cannot act as me.\n7. As a visitor who is not signed in, I want any admin address to send me to sign-in, so that I never see admin content.\n\n### First Admin and setup\n8. As the project owner, I want the first Admin account created from the command line with a password taken from the environment, so that no password is committed to Git.\n9. As the project owner, I want a clean clone to run from `.env.example` plus a few documented steps, so that a grader can reproduce the demo.\n10. As the project owner, I want the database and `.env` kept out of Git, so that private data is never published.\n11. As the project owner, I want demo data that can be rebuilt on demand, so that screenshots and tests are repeatable.\n\n### Roles and permission refusal\n12. As an Admin, I want to manage accounts and permanent Pages, so that I control who can change the site and what the Navigation contains.\n13. As an Editor, I want to create and publish Posts directly, so that an announcement can go out quickly.\n14. As an Editor, I want to edit any Post, including another Editor's, so that event details can be corrected close to the event if the writer is unavailable.\n15. As an Editor, I want to update the Body of an existing Page, so that the Photos page can stay current.\n16. As an Admin, I want only Admins to delete Posts, so that a mistaken deletion is unlikely.\n17. As an Admin, I want only Admins to create, delete, publish, unpublish, retitle or re-slug a Page, so that Navigation and links stay stable.\n18. As an Admin, I want only Admins to change a slug, and to be warned that doing so can break an old link, so that shared links keep working.\n19. As an Editor, I want admin-only controls hidden from my screens, so that my screens stay simple.\n20. As an Editor who reaches an Admin-only address or submits a forbidden action directly, I want a clear \"You don't have permission\" page with a link back to the dashboard, so that I understand what happened.\n21. As an Admin, I want every permission enforced by the server, not by hidden buttons, so that access control is real.\n\n### Posts\n22. As an Editor, I want to write a Post with a title and a Body and save it as a Draft, so that I can finish it later.\n23. As an Editor, I want to mark a Post Published, so that it is ready for the public site.\n24. As an Editor, I want to unpublish a Post, so that a wrong announcement stops going out.\n25. As an Editor, I want the slug generated from my title on first save, so that I never have to think about URLs.\n26. As an Editor, I want a number added automatically when a slug already exists, so that two Posts never collide.\n27. As an Editor, I want the slug to stay unchanged when I correct the title or event details, so that shared links keep working.\n28. As an Editor, I want a short hint reminding me to include What, When, Where and Who can attend, so that announcements are complete.\n29. As an Editor, I want the hint not pre-filled into the Body and hideable without losing content, so that I can write naturally.\n30. As an Editor, I want the Post to record me as its Author automatically, so that I do not fill in extra fields.\n31. As an Editor, I want the Post's created, updated and first-published times recorded automatically, so that dates are trustworthy.\n\n### Pages\n32. As an Admin, I want to create a Page with a title, slug and Body, so that permanent information has a home.\n33. As an Admin, I want a published Page to appear in the public Navigation automatically, so that visitors can find it.\n34. As an Admin, I want an unpublished Page to disappear from the Navigation, so that unfinished pages are not linked.\n35. As an Admin, I want to delete a Page, so that obsolete pages can be removed.\n36. As an Editor, I want to edit the Body of a Page but see title, slug, status and delete controls as unavailable, so that I cannot break the Navigation.\n\n### Writing, preview and images\n37. As an Editor, I want to use headings, emphasis, lists, links and images with alt text, so that announcements read well without learning HTML.\n38. As an Editor, I want raw HTML, scripts, frames and forms in my text stripped, so that the site is safe.\n39. As an Editor, I want a preview that shows exactly what the public page will render, so that there are no surprises after publishing.\n40. As an Editor, I want to write a caption, alt text and Markdown reference for an image, so that photos are accessible.\n41. As an Editor, I understand I cannot add a new image file myself, so that the release-holder can confirm Photo permission first.\n42. As the release-holder, I want approved image files copied into the public site with relative paths, so that photos show up after deployment.\n43. As the release-holder, I want demo illustrations labelled as illustrative and never presented as photos of real ASA events, so that visitors are not misled.\n\n### Admin console\n44. As an Admin, I want a dashboard with the counts of Published Posts, Draft Posts, Published Pages and Draft Pages, so that I see the state of the site at a glance.\n45. As an Admin, I want the dashboard to also show the number of active and Deactivated accounts, so that I can keep track of who has access.\n46. As an Editor, I want the dashboard to show the four content counts but no account counts, so that I only see what I need.\n47. As any signed-in user, I want a reminder on the dashboard that marking content Published does not make it Live until `cms publish` and `cms deploy` run, so that I do not expect instant changes.\n48. As any signed-in user, I want one Content list I can filter by Post or Page and by Draft or Published, so that I can find content without opening each item.\n49. As any signed-in user, I want each row to show title, status, Display name and last-updated time, so that I can tell items apart.\n50. As a phone user, I want the admin console usable at phone width, so that I can post from anywhere.\n\n### User management\n51. As an Admin, I want to create an account with a username, a private password, a role and a public Display name, so that a new member can start writing.\n52. As an Admin, I want to change an account's role, so that responsibilities can change.\n53. As an Admin, I want to deactivate an account, so that a former member can no longer sign in while their published Posts stay.\n54. As an Admin, I want to reactivate a deactivated account, so that a mistake is recoverable.\n55. As an Admin, I want to set a new password for an existing account without seeing the old one, so that a lost password can be recovered.\n56. As an Admin, I want a reset password never printed or logged, so that it cannot leak.\n57. As an Admin, I want to change an account's Display name, so that a former member can ask for their name to be replaced with \"ASA Events Team\".\n58. As an Admin, I want the original Author link of every Post kept, even after a Display name change or deactivation, so that the record stays accurate.\n59. As an Admin, I want the private username never used as a byline by default, so that private account names do not appear publicly.\n60. As an Admin, I want accounts deactivated rather than deleted, so that history is preserved.\n\n### Public site\n61. As a first-time visitor, I want a short welcome on the Home page, so that I know what ASA is and that I am welcome.\n62. As a visitor, I want the five latest Announcements on the Home page with a link to all of them, so that I can see what is new.\n63. As a visitor, I want an Announcements page listing all Published Posts, newest first by first-published date, so that I can browse.\n64. As a visitor, I want each Announcement as a clear Event card showing its title, first-published date and byline, so that I can scan quickly on a phone.\n65. As a visitor, I want an \"Updated\" date on a card when the content changed after first publishing, so that I know details were corrected.\n66. As a visitor, I want the event's actual date, time, location and who can attend in the Body, and the publication date never labelled as the event date, so that I am not misled.\n67. As a visitor, I want a Post to keep its original first-published date if it is unpublished and later published again, so that the order is stable.\n68. As a visitor, I want the Navigation to list Announcements and every published Page (About ASA, Resources, Photos for the demo), so that information is easy to find.\n69. As a visitor, I want the Photos page to say that actual event photos will be added when ASA has permission to use them, so that placeholders are not mistaken for real events.\n70. As a visitor, I want the public site to work on a phone with readable text, so that I can use it anywhere.\n71. As a visitor who uses a keyboard or screen reader, I want a sensible heading order, readable contrast, visible focus, keyboard access to all controls, and alt text on every image, so that the site is accessible.\n72. As a visitor, I want Drafts and unpublished content never to appear anywhere in the public site, so that unfinished work stays private.\n73. As a visitor, I want the site to work from a GitHub Pages subfolder, so that no link or style is broken.\n\n### Releasing\n74. As the release-holder, I want `cms publish` to write the public site from Published content only, so that Drafts never leave the database.\n75. As the release-holder, I want `cms deploy` to send the result to GitHub Pages, so that content becomes Live.\n76. As the release-holder, I want a short release checklist covering publish, deploy, checking relative paths, adding approved images, and confirming Photo permission, so that the step is quick and repeatable.\n77. As the release-holder, I want the checklist to state that an Editor cannot add an image file alone, so that clients are not surprised.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n- **Architecture is fixed** by ADR-001 (local admin console, static public site) and ADR-002 (FastAPI, Jinja2, SQLite, argon2, Markdown sanitizer). No new dependencies.\n- **Content model.** Two kinds of content only: Post and Page. No separate Event type and no event-date field. A Post has a title, slug, Markdown Body, status (Draft or Published), Author, and created, updated and first-published times. A Page has the same fields except that the Author is optional for display and a Page does not appear in the Announcements list.\n- **First-published date** is set the first time a Post becomes Published and never cleared, including when the Post is unpublished and republished. The **Updated date** on the public card is shown when the Body or title changes after the first-published date.\n- **Ordering.** Announcements are ordered by first-published date, newest first. Editing does not reorder. The Home page shows the five most recent; the Announcements page shows all Published Posts.\n- **Slugs.** A Post's slug is generated from its title on first save, made unique by adding a number, and never changed automatically. A Page's slug is entered by the Admin. Only the Admin can change any slug, and the form warns that this can break existing links. Slug edits are not shown to Editors.\n- **Accounts.** An account has a private username, a password hash, a role (Admin or Editor), a public Display name, and an active flag. There is no account deletion. Posts keep their Author link permanently. A Post's public byline is the Author's current Display name. The username is never used as a byline.\n- **Authentication.** Session cookie signed by the server. Passwords are hashed with argon2 and are never stored, shown or logged in plain form. Sign-in failures use one generic message. A Deactivated account cannot sign in and any existing session for it stops working.\n- **Authorization.** A single central rule table maps each action to the roles allowed. Every state-changing route checks it on the server. Templates hide controls the current role cannot use, but hiding is never the protection. A refused action shows a \"You don't have permission\" page with a link to the dashboard, and a not-signed-in visitor is sent to sign-in.\n- **Permission matrix.** Admin: everything. Editor: sign in and out; create, edit and publish or unpublish Posts, including other people's; edit the Body of an existing Page; view dashboard counts and the Content list. Editor cannot: delete Posts or Pages; create, publish, unpublish, retitle or re-slug Pages; change any slug; open user management or change any account, role or Display name; reset passwords.\n- **CSRF.** Every state-changing form carries a token that the server verifies.\n- **Markdown and sanitizing.** Allowed: headings, emphasis, lists, links and images with alt text. Raw HTML, scripts, iframes and forms are stripped. The same rendering and sanitizing path is used for the admin preview and the public export, so the preview matches the public page.\n- **Images.** No upload feature. Approved image files are added to the project by the release-holder and copied into the public site by `cms publish`. Markdown references use relative paths. Demo illustrations are clearly labelled illustrative.\n- **Admin console screens.** Sign-in, Dashboard, Content list, Post editor with Preview and the Event details hint, Page editor (reduced controls for Editors), User management (Admin only), and the permission-refusal page. Layouts work at phone width.\n- **Dashboard.** Four content counts for everyone; active and deactivated account counts for the Admin only; a reminder that Published is not Live. No \"Changes not live yet\" indicator.\n- **Content list.** One list of Posts and Pages, filterable by type and by status, with title, status, Display name and last-updated time on each row.\n- **Event details hint.** A short, dismissible hint near the Post editor listing What, When, Where and Who can attend. It is never inserted into the Body.\n- **Publishing.** `cms publish` renders Home, Announcements, each Published Post, each Published Page and the Navigation to plain HTML, using only Published content and only relative paths. It copies approved image files. `cms deploy` pushes the result to the `gh-pages` branch. Nothing is Live until both have run.\n- **Public design.** Polished, mobile-first, readable text, clear Event cards, a few appropriately licensed images or decorative graphics that are never presented as real ASA event photos. Accessibility requirements: sensible heading order, readable contrast, visible focus and full keyboard access, phone-width layout, and alt text on every image.\n- **Content carried from the client brief.** The Welcome text uses only the brief's wording. Starter Pages (About ASA, Resources, Photos) and seed Posts are demo placeholders and contain no claims about ASA's real history, officers, members, schedule or approval process.\n- **First Admin.** Created from the command line at setup, with the password read from the environment. No password, `.env` or database file is committed. A clean clone runs from `.env.example` plus documented steps.\n- **Demo data.** The seed data is rebuilt on demand and includes both roles, published and draft Posts and Pages, and a deactivated account.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- **A good test checks external behaviour only:** what a signed-in user sees and can do, and what files the publish step writes. It does not check internal functions, the database layout or template details.\n- **Seam 1: the admin console over HTTP.** Use the existing `client` and `client_as(\"admin\" | \"editor\")` fixtures. Cover sign-in and sign-out, Deactivated accounts, each row of the permission matrix (both the allowed and the refused case, for every Admin-only action), CSRF rejection, Post and Page create/read/update/delete, slug generation and stability, First-published date rules, Dashboard counts by role, Content list filtering, Preview matching public output, user management and Password reset, and Display name changes.\n- **Seam 2: the published site on disk.** Call the publish step against seeded data into a temporary folder and read the HTML files. Cover: Drafts and unpublished content absent; sanitized Markdown (raw HTML, scripts, iframes and forms stripped); Navigation built from published Pages; Announcements ordering and the five-item Home page; byline uses the Display name and never the username; \"Updated\" date shown after later edits; only relative `href` and `src` values; approved image files copied; the Welcome text present.\n- **Seam 3 (small smoke test): the `cms` command.** First-Admin creation from an environment password, and a clean-setup run from `.env.example`. Kept small and separate.\n- **Prior art.** `tests/conftest.py` already provides the app and `client_as` fixtures, and the walking-skeleton test shows the style. Read the tests before letting them pass, to catch a test written against a misunderstanding.\n- **Security checks.** Drafts never appear in the export, no plain password in any response or log, no root-absolute paths in the export, sanitized output, CSRF on every state-changing form, and server-side enforcement of every Admin-only action.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- A separate Event content type, an event-date field, and automatic upcoming/past sorting.\n- Photo upload forms, automatic gallery management, and photo approvals enforced by software. (The Photos page with approved images is in scope.)\n- Account deletion, and a first-login password change flow.\n- Email sending, including email-based password reset.\n- A \"Changes not live yet\" indicator.\n- RSVPs and sign-ups, comments, search, and tags or categories.\n- Multi-site support, drag-and-drop page building, and a rich-text WYSIWYG editor.\n- Any claim about ASA's real history, members, leaders, schedule or approval process.\n\n## Further Notes\n\n- **Release checklist.** Written as part of the project. It covers running publish and deploy, the relative-path check, adding approved image files, confirming Photo permission before a real photo is added, and the limit that an Editor cannot add an image file alone. Association at Kenyon, is described in the client brief as a student group primarily for African students and students with African backgrounds, while welcoming anyone interested in African cultures and community. Students need an easy way to find event announcements (including an Afrobeat event), learn about the association, explore cultural resources, and see photos from past activities. Its leaders need event announcements to be quick to publish, information about ASA to stay easy to find in the navigation, and a way to share photos only when ASA has permission to use them. One ASA leader should manage accounts and permanent pages; another member should be able to write and update event posts without a complicated form.\n\nThis is a class project (IPHS 400, Mini-Project #2). No claim is made about any real ASA process, officers, schedule or history. Terms below are defined in `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n## Solution\n\nA small CMS. A local admin console lets an Admin and Editors write **Posts** and **Pages**, manage accounts, and preview content. A `cms publish` step renders only **Published** content into a static public site, and `cms deploy` sends it to GitHub Pages, at which point the content is **Live**. The admin console never goes on the public internet (ADR-001).\n\nThe public site has a **Home page** (a short **Welcome text** taken from the client brief plus the five latest **Announcements**), an **Announcements** list, and **Navigation** built from published Pages (starter Pages for the demo: About ASA, Resources, Photos). Event announcements are ordinary Posts with the event's date, time, location and who can attend written in the **Body**. Photos are images inside Posts or Pages; there is no upload form.\n\n## User Stories\n\n### Signing in\n1. As an Admin, I want to sign in with a username and password, so that only authorised people can change the site.\n2. As an Editor, I want to sign in and out, so that my session ends when I leave a shared computer.\n3. As an account owner, I want my password stored hashed, so that nobody, including the Admin, can read it.\n4. As an Admin, I want a wrong password to be rejected with a clear message that does not reveal whether the username exists, so that accounts cannot be guessed.\n5. As someone with a Deactivated account, I want sign-in to be refused, so that a former member can no longer change the site.\n6. As a signed-in user, I want every form I submit to be protected against forged requests, so that another website cannot act as me.\n7. As a visitor who is not signed in, I want any admin address to send me to sign-in, so that I never see admin content.\n\n### First Admin and setup\n8. As the project owner, I want the first Admin account created from the command line with a password taken from the environment, so that no password is committed to Git.\n9. As the project owner, I want a clean clone to run from `.env.example` plus a few documented steps, so that a grader can reproduce the demo.\n10. As the project owner, I want the database and `.env` kept out of Git, so that private data is never published.\n11. As the project owner, I want demo data that can be rebuilt on demand, so that screenshots and tests are repeatable.\n\n### Roles and permission refusal\n12. As an Admin, I want to manage accounts and permanent Pages, so that I control who can change the site and what the Navigation contains.\n13. As an Editor, I want to create and publish Posts directly, so that an announcement can go out quickly.\n14. As an Editor, I want to edit any Post, including another Editor's, so that event details can be corrected close to the event if the writer is unavailable.\n15. As an Editor, I want to update the Body of an existing Page, so that the Photos page can stay current.\n16. As an Admin, I want only Admins to delete Posts, so that a mistaken deletion is unlikely.\n17. As an Admin, I want only Admins to create, delete, publish, unpublish, retitle or re-slug a Page, so that Navigation and links stay stable.\n18. As an Admin, I want only Admins to change a slug, and to be warned that doing so can break an old link, so that shared links keep working.\n19. As an Editor, I want admin-only controls hidden from my screens, so that my screens stay simple.\n20. As an Editor who reaches an Admin-only address or submits a forbidden action directly, I want a clear \"You don't have permission\" page with a link back to the dashboard, so that I understand what happened.\n21. As an Admin, I want every permission enforced by the server, not by hidden buttons, so that access control is real.\n\n### Posts\n22. As an Editor, I want to write a Post with a title and a Body and save it as a Draft, so that I can finish it later.\n23. As an Editor, I want to mark a Post Published, so that it is ready for the public site.\n24. As an Editor, I want to unpublish a Post, so that a wrong announcement stops going out.\n25. As an Editor, I want the slug generated from my title on first save, so that I never have to think about URLs.\n26. As an Editor, I want a number added automatically when a slug already exists, so that two Posts never collide.\n27. As an Editor, I want the slug to stay unchanged when I correct the title or event details, so that shared links keep working.\n28. As an Editor, I want a short hint reminding me to include What, When, Where and Who can attend, so that announcements are complete.\n29. As an Editor, I want the hint not pre-filled into the Body and hideable without losing content, so that I can write naturally.\n30. As an Editor, I want the Post to record me as its Author automatically, so that I do not fill in extra fields.\n31. As an Editor, I want the Post's created, updated and first-published times recorded automatically, so that dates are trustworthy.\n\n### Pages\n32. As an Admin, I want to create a Page with a title, slug and Body, so that permanent information has a home.\n33. As an Admin, I want a published Page to appear in the public Navigation automatically, so that visitors can find it.\n34. As an Admin, I want an unpublished Page to disappear from the Navigation, so that unfinished pages are not linked.\n35. As an Admin, I want to delete a Page, so that obsolete pages can be removed.\n36. As an Editor, I want to edit the Body of a Page but see title, slug, status and delete controls as unavailable, so that I cannot break the Navigation.\n\n### Writing, preview and images\n37. As an Editor, I want to use headings, emphasis, lists, links and images with alt text, so that announcements read well without learning HTML.\n38. As an Editor, I want raw HTML, scripts, frames and forms in my text stripped, so that the site is safe.\n39. As an Editor, I want a preview that shows exactly what the public page will render, so that there are no surprises after publishing.\n40. As an Editor, I want to write a caption, alt text and Markdown reference for an image, so that photos are accessible.\n41. As an Editor, I understand I cannot add a new image file myself, so that the release-holder can confirm Photo permission first.\n42. As the release-holder, I want approved image files copied into the public site with relative paths, so that photos show up after deployment.\n43. As the release-holder, I want demo illustrations labelled as illustrative and never presented as photos of real ASA events, so that visitors are not misled.\n\n### Admin console\n44. As an Admin, I want a dashboard with the counts of Published Posts, Draft Posts, Published Pages and Draft Pages, so that I see the state of the site at a glance.\n45. As an Admin, I want the dashboard to also show the number of active and Deactivated accounts, so that I can keep track of who has access.\n46. As an Editor, I want the dashboard to show the four content counts but no account counts, so that I only see what I need.\n47. As any signed-in user, I want a reminder on the dashboard that marking content Published does not make it Live until `cms publish` and `cms deploy` run, so that I do not expect instant changes.\n48. As any signed-in user, I want one Content list I can filter by Post or Page and by Draft or Published, so that I can find content without opening each item.\n49. As any signed-in user, I want each row to show title, status, Display name and last-updated time, so that I can tell items apart.\n50. As a phone user, I want the admin console usable at phone width, so that I can post from anywhere.\n\n### User management\n51. As an Admin, I want to create an account with a username, a private password, a role and a public Display name, so that a new member can start writing.\n52. As an Admin, I want to change an account's role, so that responsibilities can change.\n53. As an Admin, I want to deactivate an account, so that a former member can no longer sign in while their published Posts stay.\n54. As an Admin, I want to reactivate a deactivated account, so that a mistake is recoverable.\n55. As an Admin, I want to set a new password for an existing account without seeing the old one, so that a lost password can be recovered.\n56. As an Admin, I want a reset password never printed or logged, so that it cannot leak.\n57. As an Admin, I want to change an account's Display name, so that a former member can ask for their name to be replaced with \"ASA Events Team\".\n58. As an Admin, I want the original Author link of every Post kept, even after a Display name change or deactivation, so that the record stays accurate.\n59. As an Admin, I want the private username never used as a byline by default, so that private account names do not appear publicly.\n60. As an Admin, I want accounts deactivated rather than deleted, so that history is preserved.\n\n### Public site\n61. As a first-time visitor, I want a short welcome on the Home page, so that I know what ASA is and that I am welcome.\n62. As a visitor, I want the five latest Announcements on the Home page with a link to all of them, so that I can see what is new.\n63. As a visitor, I want an Announcements page listing all Published Posts, newest first by first-published date, so that I can browse.\n64. As a visitor, I want each Announcement as a clear Event card showing its title, first-published date and byline, so that I can scan quickly on a phone.\n65. As a visitor, I want an \"Updated\" date on a card when the content changed after first publishing, so that I know details were corrected.\n66. As a visitor, I want the event's actual date, time, location and who can attend in the Body, and the publication date never labelled as the event date, so that I am not misled.\n67. As a visitor, I want a Post to keep its original first-published date if it is unpublished and later published again, so that the order is stable.\n68. As a visitor, I want the Navigation to list Announcements and every published Page (About ASA, Resources, Photos for the demo), so that information is easy to find.\n69. As a visitor, I want the Photos page to say that actual event photos will be added when ASA has permission to use them, so that placeholders are not mistaken for real events.\n70. As a visitor, I want the public site to work on a phone with readable text, so that I can use it anywhere.\n71. As a visitor who uses a keyboard or screen reader, I want a sensible heading order, readable contrast, visible focus, keyboard access to all controls, and alt text on every image, so that the site is accessible.\n72. As a visitor, I want Drafts and unpublished content never to appear anywhere in the public site, so that unfinished work stays private.\n73. As a visitor, I want the site to work from a GitHub Pages subfolder, so that no link or style is broken.\n\n### Releasing\n74. As the release-holder, I want `cms publish` to write the public site from Published content only, so that Drafts never leave the database.\n75. As the release-holder, I want `cms deploy` to send the result to GitHub Pages, so that content becomes Live.\n76. As the release-holder, I want a short release checklist covering publish, deploy, checking relative paths, adding approved images, and confirming Photo permission, so that the step is quick and repeatable.\n77. As the release-holder, I want the checklist to state that an Editor cannot add an image file alone, so that clients are not surprised.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n- **Architecture is fixed** by ADR-001 (local admin console, static public site) and ADR-002 (FastAPI, Jinja2, SQLite, argon2, Markdown sanitizer). No new dependencies.\n- **Content model.** Two kinds of content only: Post and Page. No separate Event type and no event-date field. A Post has a title, slug, Markdown Body, status (Draft or Published), Author, and created, updated and first-published times. A Page has the same fields except that the Author is optional for display and a Page does not appear in the Announcements list.\n- **First-published date** is set the first time a Post becomes Published and never cleared, including when the Post is unpublished and republished. The **Updated date** on the public card is shown when the Body or title changes after the first-published date.\n- **Ordering.** Announcements are ordered by first-published date, newest first. Editing does not reorder. The Home page shows the five most recent; the Announcements page shows all Published Posts.\n- **Slugs.** A Post's slug is generated from its title on first save, made unique by adding a number, and never changed automatically. A Page's slug is entered by the Admin. Only the Admin can change any slug, and the form warns that this can break existing links. Slug edits are not shown to Editors.\n- **Accounts.** An account has a private username, a password hash, a role (Admin or Editor), a public Display name, and an active flag. There is no account deletion. Posts keep their Author link permanently. A Post's public byline is the Author's current Display name. The username is never used as a byline.\n- **Authentication.** Session cookie signed by the server. Passwords are hashed with argon2 and are never stored, shown or logged in plain form. Sign-in failures use one generic message. A Deactivated account cannot sign in and any existing session for it stops working.\n- **Authorization.** A single central rule table maps each action to the roles allowed. Every state-changing route checks it on the server. Templates hide controls the current role cannot use, but hiding is never the protection. A refused action shows a \"You don't have permission\" page with a link to the dashboard, and a not-signed-in visitor is sent to sign-in.\n- **Permission matrix.** Admin: everything. Editor: sign in and out; create, edit and publish or unpublish Posts, including other people's; edit the Body of an existing Page; view dashboard counts and the Content list. Editor cannot: delete Posts or Pages; create, publish, unpublish, retitle or re-slug Pages; change any slug; open user management or change any account, role or Display name; reset passwords.\n- **CSRF.** Every state-changing form carries a token that the server verifies.\n- **Markdown and sanitizing.** Allowed: headings, emphasis, lists, links and images with alt text. {"parentUuid":"b4caf141-35a8-4a4f-b468-e2e6250b5ef7","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"871c469d-8dd5-440e-9b1e-0b643bb2d2d3","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014Hzoh9QRaUyqcrAsybRsbZ","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The admin console. Everything under /admin is guarded by security.AdminGuard.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Request\n\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", title=\"Dashboard\",\n                  user=request.state.user)\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (signed-in only), with /login and /logout\nbeside it; the public site preview answers at /.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.permissions import PermissionRefused\nfrom app.publish import WELCOME\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, pages, posts, users\nfrom app.web import render, templates\n\nSESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60\n\n\ndef create_app(database: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    # Every state-changing request is CSRF-checked, whatever route it reaches.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(security.verify_csrf)])\n    app.state.database = database or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(PermissionRefused)\n    def refuse(request: Request, _: PermissionRefused):\n        return render(request, \"admin/refused.html\", status_code=403,\n                      title=\"No permission\", user=request.state.user)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"root\": \"\", \"welcome\": WELCOME, \"posts\": []},\n        )\n\n    # Middleware added last is outermost: the session must be loaded before the\n    # guard runs, and saved after it.\n    app.add_middleware(security.AdminGuard)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY, session_cookie=\"cms_session\",\n        max_age=SESSION_LIFETIME_SECONDS, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"The one place that says who may do what.\n\nEvery state-changing or Admin-only route asks `require(action)`. Templates ask\n`can(role, action)` only to hide controls; hiding is never the protection.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\nEVERYONE = frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR})\nADMIN_ONLY = frozenset({ADMIN})\n\nRULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"post.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.create\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.edit\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.publish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.unpublish\": EVERYONE,\n    \"post.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"post.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.list\": EVERYONE,\n    \"page.edit_body\": EVERYONE,\n    \"page.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.retitle\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.change_slug\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.publish\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.unpublish\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"page.delete\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.list\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.view\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.create\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.change_role\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.deactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.reactivate\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.reset_password\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n    \"user.change_display_name\": ADMIN_ONLY,\n}\n\n\nclass PermissionRefused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The signed-in account's role may not do this action.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef allowed(role: str, action: str) -> bool:\n    # An action missing from the table is refused, never allowed by accident.\n    return role in RULES.get(action, frozenset())\n\n\ndef require(action: str):\n    \"\"\"A route dependency: refuse the request unless the role may `action`.\n\n    Runs before the route looks anything up, so an Editor gets the same\n    refusal whether or not the thing they asked about exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if action not in RULES:\n        raise KeyError(f\"unknown action: {action}\")\n\n    def check(request: Request) -> None:\n        if not allowed(request.state.user[\"role\"], action):\n            raise PermissionRefused(action)\n\n    return check\n\"\"\"Template rendering for the admin console.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import permissions, security, settings\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n# Templates use this only to hide controls; the server still checks every request.\ntemplates.env.globals[\"can\"] = permissions.allowed\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef route(context, name: str, **params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of a named route, e.g. route('edit_post', post_id=3).\n\n    Templates use this instead of writing \"/admin/...\" by hand, so a link or\n    form action follows its route if the route's path ever changes.\n    \"\"\"\n    return context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **params)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"route\"] = route\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, name: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    \"\"\"Render an admin template with the CSRF token every form needs.\"\"\"\n    context.setdefault(\"title\", \"Admin\")\n    context[\"csrf_token\"] = security.csrf_token(request)\n    context[\"home_path\"] = request.app.url_path_for(\"dashboard\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, name, context, status_code=status_code)\n\"\"\"SQLite access. One short-lived connection per unit of work.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),\n    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title              TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug               TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body               TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                               CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    updated_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    first_published_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                       CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef connect(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, creating the file and tables on first use.\n\n    Use as `with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:` so the connection is\n    closed and the transaction commits (or rolls back on error).\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n    return conn\n\"\"\"Posts: the data rules (slugs, Author, First-published date).\n\nNothing here knows about HTTP. Slugs are made once from the title and only\nchange through `change_slug`, which the routes reserve for the Admin.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\n\nclass PostError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A request about a Post that cannot be honoured (shown to the person).\"\"\"\n\n\nclass TitleRequired(PostError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass SlugInvalid(PostError):\n    pass\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(PostError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, base: str) -> str:\n    slug, number = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        number += 1\n        slug = f\"{base}-{number}\"\n    return slug\n\n\ndef The username is private (sign-in only); the Display name is the\npublic byline. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\nROLES = (\"admin\", \"editor\")\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked when the username is unknown, so a miss takes as long as a wrong\n# password and timing does not reveal which usernames exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(\"not-a-real-password\")\n\n\nclass AccountError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A request about an account that cannot be honoured (shown to the Admin).\"\"\"\n\n\nclass UsernameTaken(AccountError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef hash_password(password: str) -> str:\n    return _hasher.hash(password)\n\n\ndef _password_matches(stored_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(stored_hash, password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef _check_password_length(password: str) -> None:\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise AccountError(\n            f\"The password must be at least {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.\")\n\n\ndef create_account(path: Path, *, username: str, password: str, role: str,\n                   display_name: str) -> int:\n    username, display_name = username.strip(), display_name.strip()\n    if not username or not display_name:\n        raise AccountError(\"A username and a Display name are required.\")\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise AccountError(f\"Role must be one of: {', '.join(ROLES)}.\")\n    _check_password_length(password)\n    try:\n        with closing(connect(path)) as conn, conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role, display_name) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (username, hash_password(password), role, display_name),\n            )\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise UsernameTaken(f\"An account named '{username}' already exists.\") from None\n\n\ndef authenticate(path: Path, username: str, password: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the account for a correct username and password, else None.\n\n    An unknown username, a wrong password and a Deactivated account all return\n    None, so the caller can give one generic message for all three.\n    \"\"\"\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        user = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?\", (username.strip(),)\n is_refusal, post_to\n\nLINK = re.compile(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nFORM = re.compile(r'<form [^>]*action=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef local_links(html):\n    return [h for h in LINK.findall(html) if h.startswith(\"/\")]\n\n\ndef form_actions(html):\n    return FORM.findall(html)\n\n\ndef test_admin_templates_hard_code_no_root_absolute_path():\n    for path in (settings.TEMPLATES / \"admin\").glob(\"*.html\"):\n        text = path.read_text()\n        for attr in ('href=\"/', 'src=\"/', 'action=\"/'):\n            assert attr not in text, f\"{path.name} writes {attr}...\\\" by hand\"\n\n\ndef test_every_link_reachable_from_the_dashboard_answers(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_id = create_post(admin, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    seen, queue = set(), [\"/admin\"]\n    while queue:\n        url = queue.pop()\n        if url in seen:\n            continue\n        seen.add(url)\n        response = admin.get(url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, f\"{url} -> {response.status_code}\"\n        queue += [u for u in local_links(response.text) if u not in seen]\n    # the crawl really walked the nested routes, not just the top level\n    assert {\"/admin\", \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\",\n            f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\"} <= seen\n\n\ndef test_post_form_actions_point_at_the_nested_routes(client_as):\n    admin = f\"{base}/publish\", f\"{base}/slug\", f\"{base}/delete\"]\n    admin_new = admin.get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n    assert form_actions(admin_new) == [\"/admin/posts\"]\n\n\ndef test_each_form_action_on_the_edit_page_does_its_job(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_id = create_post(admin, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    edit_url = f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\"\n\n    def submit_form(index, **data):\n        action = form_actions(edit_page(admin, post_id))[index]\n        return post_to(admin, action, **data)\n\n    saved = post_id)\n\n    published = submit_form(1)\n    assert published.headers[\"location\"] == edit_url\n    assert 'id=\"post-status\">Published<' in edit_page(admin, post_id)\n\n    # once Published, the second form becomes Unpublish and still works\n    unpublished = submit_form(1)\n    assert unpublished.headers[\"location\"] == edit_url\n    assert 'id=\"post-status\">Draft<' in edit_page(admin, post_id)\n\n    slugged = submit_form(2, slug=\"afrobeat-night-final\")\n    assert slugged.headers[\"location\"] == edit_url\n    assert \"afrobeat-night-final\" in edit_page(admin, post_id)\n\n    deleted = submit_form(3)\n    assert deleted.status_code == 303 and deleted.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/posts\"\n    assert admin.get(edit_url).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_signed_out_sign_in_form_posts_and_sign_out_form_returns_to_it(client):\n    (action,) = form_actions(client.get(\"/login\").text)\n    assert action == \"/login\"\n    user = DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"]\n    signed_in = client.post(action, data={\n        \"username\": user[\"username\"], \"password\": user[\"password\"],\n        \"csrf_token\": csrf_token(client)}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert signed_in.status_code == 303 and signed_in.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin\"\n\n    dashboard = client.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"/admin/posts\" in local_links(dashboard)\n    (logout,) = form_actions(dashboard)\n    signed_out = post_to(client, logout)\n    assert signed_out.status_code == 303 and signed_out.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n    assert client.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False).status_code in (302, 303)\n\n\ndef test_the_permission_refusal_page_links_back_to_the_dashboard(client_as):\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = create_post(editor, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    refused = post_to(editor, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    assert is_refusal(refused)\n assert admin.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\"\"\"Who is signed in, and CSRF protection.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette SessionMiddleware). It holds only the\naccount id and a CSRF token. \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in, active account for this request, or None.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = accounts.get_user(request.app.state.database, user_id)\n    if user is None or not user[\"active\"]:\n        request.session.clear()\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef sign_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on sign-in, so nothing from before it lives on.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n\n\ndef sign_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject any state-changing request that lacks this session's token.\n\n    Registered on the whole app, so a new route cannot forget it.\n    \"\"\"\n    if request.method in the Dashboard counts and the filterable Content list.\n\nSeam 1 (the admin console over HTTP): what a signed-in person sees on the\nDashboard and in the Content list, for each role, after content changes.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import accounts, pages, posts\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_token\nfrom tests.test_t03_publish import add_post, author_id\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import add_page, create_page\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import post_to as post_to_page\n\nCONTENT = \"/admin/content\"\nFOUR = (\"published-posts\", \"draft-posts\", \"published-pages\", \"draft-pages\")\n\n\ndef counts(html):\n    \"\"\"The four content counts as {name: int}, from id=\"count-<name>\".\"\"\"\n    found = {name: re.search(rf'id=\"count-{name}\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html) for name in FOUR}\n    assert all(found.values()), f\"a content count is missing: {found}\"\n    return {name: int(match.group(1)) for name, match in found.items()}\n\n\ndef account_counts(html):\n    active = re.search(r'id=\"count-active-accounts\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)\n    deactivated = re.search(r'id=\"count-deactivated-accounts\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)\n    return (int(active.group(1)), int(deactivated.group(1))) if active and deactivated else None\n\n\ndef rows(html):\n    \"\"\"Each Content list row as a dict of what it shows.\"\"\"\n    result = []\n    for block in re.findall(r'<li class=\"content-row\".*?</li>', html, re.S):\n        def field(name):\n            match = re.search(rf'class=\"row-{name}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</', block, re.S)\n            return re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \"\", match.group(1)).strip() if match else None\n        updated = re.search(r'<time class=\"row-updated\" datetime=\"([^\"]*)\"', block)\n        result.append({\"title\": field(\"title\"), \"type\": field(\"type\"),\n                       \"status\": field(\"status\"), \"author\": field(\"author\"),\n                       \"updated\": updated.group(1) if updated else None,\n                       \"href\": re.search(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"', block).group(1)})\n    return result\n\n\ndef titles(html):\n    return [row[\"title\"] for row in rows(html)]\n\n\ndef listing(client, **query):\n    response = client.get(CONTENT, params=query)\n    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text\n    return response.text\n\n\ndef add_account(db_path, username, display_name, role=\"editor\"):\n    return accounts.create_account(db_path, username=username, password=\"pass-word-99\",\n                                   role=role, display_name=display_name)\n\n\ndef seed_mix(db_path):\n    \"\"\"2 Published and 1 Draft Post; 1 Published and 2 Draft Pages.\"\"\"\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Movie Evening\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Draft Idea\", published=False)\n    add_page(db_path, \"About ASA\")\n    add_page(db_path, \"Resources\", published=False)\n    add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", published=False)\n\n\n# == the Dashboard counts ======================================================\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\ndef test_every_signed_in_user_sees_the_four_content_counts(client_as, db_path, role):\n    seed_mix(db_path)\n    assert counts(client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text) == {\n        \"published-posts\": 2, \"draft-posts\": 1, \"published-pages\": 1, \"draft-pages\": 2}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\ndef test_an_empty_site_shows_zero_not_nothing(client_as, role):\n    assert counts(client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text) == dict.fromkeys(FOUR, 0)\n\n\ndef test_the_admin_also_sees_active_and_deactivated_account_counts(client_as, db_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert account_counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text) == (2, 0)\n    add_account(db_path, \"amara\", \"Amara O.\")\n    former = add_account(db_path, \"kofi\", \"Kofi A.\")\n    accounts.deactivate(db_path, former, acting_user_id=author_id(db_path, \"admin\"))\n    assert account_counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text) == (3, 1)\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_never_sees_account_numbers_anywhere(client_as, db_path):\n    former = add_account(db_path, \"kofi\", \"Kofi A.\")\n    accounts.deactivate(db_path, former, acting_user_id=author_id(db_path, \"admin\"))\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for url in (\"/admin\", CONTENT, f\"{CONTENT}?type=post\", f\"{CONTENT}?status=draft\"):\n        html = editor.get(url).text\n        assert account_counts(html) is None, url\n        assert \"count-active-accounts\" not in html\n        assert \"count-deactivated-accounts\" not in html\n        assert \"deactivated accounts\" not in html.lower()\n        assert \"active accounts\" not in html.lower()\n\n\ndef test_account_numbers_cannot_be_asked_for_by_a_direct_request(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    for url in (\"/admin?counts=accounts\", \"/admin?role=admin\", f\"{CONTENT}?show=accounts\",\n                \"/admin/counts\", \"/admin/accounts/count\"):\n        response = editor.get(url)\n        assert account_counts(response.text) is None, url\n        assert \"deactivated\" not in response.text.lower(), url\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\ndef test_the_dashboard_reminds_that_published_is_not_live(client_as, role):\n    html = client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text\n    reminder = re.search(r'id=\"live-reminder\"[^>]*>(.*?)</', html, re.S)\n    assert reminder, \"no Live reminder\"\n    text = re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \"\", re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", reminder.group(1))).lower()\n    assert \"published\" in text and \"live\" in text\n    assert \"cms publish\" in html and \"cms deploy\" in html\n    assert \"changes not live yet\" not in html.lower()\n\n\ndef test_the_dashboard_counts_link_to_the_matching_filtered_list(client_as, db_path):\n    seed_mix(db_path)\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    html = admin.get(\"/admin\").text\n    for name, expected in ((\"published-posts\", {\"Afrobeat Night\", \"Movie Evening\"}),\n                           (\"draft-pages\", {\"Resources\", \"Photos\"})):\n        block = re.search(rf'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>[^<]*<[^>]*id=\"count-{name}\"', html)\n        assert block, f\"count-{name} is not a link\"\n        target = author_id\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import add_page, create_page\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import post_to as post_to_page\n\nCONTENT = \"/admin/content\"\nFOUR = (\"published-posts\", \"draft-posts\", \"published-pages\", \"draft-pages\")\n\n\ndef counts(html):\n    \"\"\"The four content counts as {name: int}, from id=\"count-<name>\".\"\"\"\n    found = {name: re.search(rf'id=\"count-{name}\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html) for name in FOUR}\n    assert all(found.values()), f\"a content count is missing: {found}\"\n    return {name: int(match.group(1)) for name, match in found.items()}\n\n\ndef account_counts(html):\n    active = re.search(r'id=\"count-active-accounts\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)\n    deactivated = re.search(r'id=\"count-deactivated-accounts\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html)\n    return (int(active.group(1)), int(deactivated.group(1))) if active and deactivated else None\n\n\ndef rows(html):\n    \"\"\"Each Content list row as a dict of what it shows.\"\"\"\n    result = []\n    for block in re.findall(r'<li class=\"content-row\".*?</li>', html, re.S):\n        def field(name):\n            match = re.search(rf'class=\"row-{name}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</', block, re.S)\n            return re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \"\", match.group(1)).strip() if match else None\n        updated = re.search(r'<time class=\"row-updated\" datetime=\"([^\"]*)\"', block)\n        result.append({\"title\": field(\"title\"), \"type\": field(\"type\"),\n                       \"status\": field(\"status\"), \"author\": field(\"author\"),\n                       \"updated\": updated.group(1) if updated else None,\n                       \"href\": re.search(r'<a [^>]*href=\"([^\"]*)\"', block).group(1)})\n    return result\n\n\ndef titles(html):\n    return [row[\"title\"] for row in rows(html)]\n\n\ndef listing(client, **query):\n    response = client.get(CONTENT, params=query)\n    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text\n    return response.text\n\n\ndef add_account(db_path, username, display_name, role=\"editor\"):\n    return accounts.create_account(db_path, username=username, password=\"pass-word-99\",\n                                   role=role, display_name=display_name)\n\n\ndef seed_mix(db_path):\n    \"\"\"2 Published and 1 Draft Post; 1 Published and 2 Draft Pages.\"\"\"\n    add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Movie Evening\")\n    add_post(db_path, \"Draft Idea\", published=False)\n    add_page(db_path, \"About ASA\")\n    add_page(db_path, \"Resources\", published=False)\n    add_page(db_path, \"Photos\", published=False)\n\n\n# == the Dashboard counts ======================================================\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\ndef test_every_signed_in_user_sees_the_four_content_counts(client_as, db_path, 2}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\ndef test_an_empty_site_shows_zero_not_nothing(client_as, role):\n    assert counts(client_as(role).get(\"/admin\").text) == former, acting_user_id=author_id(db_path, \"admin\"))\n    assert account_counts(admin.get(\"/admin\").text) == (3, 1)\n\n\ndef test_an_editor_never_sees_account_numbers_anywhere(client_as, re.search(rf'id=\"count-{name}\"[^>]*>\\s*(\\d+)\\s*<', html) for name in FOUR}\n    assert all(found.values()), f\"a content count is missing: {found}\"\n    return {name: int(match.group(1)) for \"\"\"Each Content list row as a dict of what it shows.\"\"\"\n    result = []\n    for block in re.findall(r'<li class=\"content-row\".*?</li>', html, re.S):\n        def field(name):\n            match = re.search(rf'class=\"row-{name}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</', block, re.S)\n            return re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \"\", match.group(1)).strip() if match else None\n        updated = re.search(r'<time class=\"row-updated\" datetime=\"([^\"]*)\"', block)\n        result.append({\"title\": field(\"title\"), \"type\": field(\"type\"),\n                       \"status\": field(\"status\"), \"author\": body=\"x\",\n                 author_id=author_id(db_path))\n    html = listing(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    assert \"<script>alert(1)</script>\" not in html\n\n\ndef test_each_row_links_to_its_editor(client_as, db_path):\n    post_id = add_post(db_path, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    page_id = add_page(db_path, \"About ASA\")\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    hrefs = {row[\"title\"]: row[\"href\"] for row in rows(listing(editor))}\n    assert hrefs == {\"Afrobeat Night\": f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\",\n                     \"About ASA\": f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\"}\n    for href in hrefs.values():\n        assert editor.get(href).status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_the_most_recently_updated_comes_first(client_as, db_path):\n written\", \"Middle page\", \"First written\"]\n    posts.update(db_path, first, title=\"First written\", body=\"corrected\")\n    assert titles(listing(client_as(\"editor\")))[0] == \"First written\"\n\n\ndef test_the_dashboard_and_list_link_to_each_other(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert CONTENT in re.findall(r'href=\"([^\"]*)\"', editor.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    assert \"/admin\" in re.findall(r'href=\"([^\"]*)\"', editor.get(CONTENT).text)\n\n\n# == both screens follow content changes immediately ===========================\n\ndef snapshot(client):\n    return counts(client.get(\"/admin\").text), {\n        (row[\"type\"], row[\"title\"], row[\"status\"]) for row in rows(listing(client))}\n\n\ndef test_counts_and_list_follow_a_post_through_its_life(client_as):\n    from tests.test_t02_posts import create_post, post_to\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    zero = dict.fromkeys(FOUR, 0)\n\n    post_id = create_post(admin, \"Afrobeat Night\")\n    assert snapshot(admin) == ({**zero, \"draft-posts\": 1},\n                               {(\"Post\", \"Afrobeat Night\", \"Draft\")})\n\n    post_to(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/publish\")\n    assert snapshot(admin) == ({**zero, \"published-posts\": 1},\n                               {(\"Post\", \"Afrobeat Night\", \"Published\")})\n\n    post_to(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/publish\")        # now Unpublish\n    assert snapshot(admin) == ({**zero, \"draft-posts\": 1},\n                               {(\"Post\", \"Afrobeat Night\", \"Draft\")})\n\n    post_to(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    assert snapshot(admin) == (zero, set())\n\n\ndef test_counts_and_list_follow_a_page_through_its_life(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    zero = dict.fromkeys(FOUR, 0)\n\n    page_id = create_page(admin, \"About ASA\", \"about-asa\")\n    assert snapshot(admin) == ({**zero, \"draft-pages\": 1},\n                               {(\"Page\", \"About ASA\", \"Draft\")})\n\n    post_to_page(admin, f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/publish\")\n    assert snapshot(admin) == ({**zero, \"published-pages\": 1},\n                               {(\"Page\", \"About ASA\", \"Published\")})\n\n    post_to_page(admin, f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/publish\")   # now Unpublish\n    assert snapshot(admin) == ({**zero, \"draft-pages\": 1},\n                               {(\"Page\", \"About ASA\", \"Draft\")})\n\n    post_to_page(admin, f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/delete\")\n    assert snapshot(admin) == (zero, set())\n\n\ndef test_an_editors_edit_shows_in_the_list_straight_away(client_as, db_path):\n    from tests.test_t02_posts Both are read fresh from the database on every\ncall, so they always match the content as it is now.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\nTYPES = (\"post\", \"page\")\nSTATUSES = (\"draft\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef counts(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Posts and Pages by status, e.g. counts[\"published_posts\"].\"\"\"\n    result = {f\"{status}_{kind}s\": 0 for status in STATUSES for kind in TYPES}\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        for kind in TYPES:\n            for status, number in conn.execute(\n                    f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {kind}s GROUP BY status\"):\n                result[f\"{status}_{kind}s\"] = number\n    return result\n\n\ndef list_items(path: Path, *, kind: str | None = None,\n               status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Posts and Pages in one list, most recently updated first.\n\n    `kind` (\"post\" or \"page\") and `status` (\"draft\" or \"published\") each narrow\n    the list; None means no narrowing. Each row has: kind, id, title, status,\n    author_name (None for a Page with no Author) and updated_at.\n    \"\"\"\n    wanted = [k for k in TYPES if kind in (None, k)]\n    selects = [\n        f\"SELECT '{k}' AS kind, {k}s.id, {k}s.title, {k}s.status, \"\n        f\"users.display_name AS author_name, {k}s.updated_at \"\n        f\"FROM {k}s LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = {k}s.author_id\"\n        + (f\" WHERE {k}s.status = ?\" if status else \"\")\n        for k in wanted\n    ]\n    params = [status] * len(wanted) if status else []\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \" UNION ALL \".join(selects) + \" ORDER BY updated_at DESC, kind, id DESC\",\n            params).fetchall()\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nimport re\np='app/accounts.py'\ns=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''def _found(conn''','''def count_by_status(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"(active, Deactivated) account counts. Everything under /admin is guarded by security.AdminGuard.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, content\nfrom app.permissions import allowed, require\nfrom app.web import render\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request):\n    user, database = request.state.user, request.app.state.database\n    # Account numbers are fetched only for the Admin, so they never reach an\n    # Editor's page even by mistake in the template.\n    account_counts = (accounts.count_by_status(database)\n                      if allowed(user[\"role\"], \"dashboard.account_counts\") else None)\n    return render(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", title=\"Dashboard\", user=user,\n                  counts=content.counts(database), account_counts=account_counts)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/content\", dependencies=[Depends(require(\"content.list\"))])\ndef content_list(request: Request, type: str = \"\", status: str = \"\"):\n    # {"parentUuid":"9428a9a1-5363-488d-892d-9800658835a6","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"871c469d-8dd5-440e-9b1e-0b643bb2d2d3","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011T3DH6e6qLuU6BkFCFgwBq","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"80e0abd4-c505-4887-8b7e-0c9af027cb36","timestamp":"2026-10-12T04:43:44.187Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","oldString":"        f\"SELECT '{k}' AS kind, {k}s.id, {k}s.title, {k}s.status, \"\n        f\"users.display_name AS author_name, {k}s.updated_at \"","newString":"        f\"SELECT '{k}' AS kind, {k}s.id AS id, {k}s.title AS title, \"\n        f\"{k}s.status AS status, users.display_name AS author_name, \"\n        f\"{k}s.updated_at AS updated_at \"","originalFile":"\"\"\"The Dashboard counts and the Content list: Posts and Pages seen together.\n\nNothing here knows about HTTP. Both are read fresh from the database on every\ncall, so they always match the content as it is now.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import closing\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app.db import connect\n\nTYPES = (\"post\", \"page\")\nSTATUSES = (\"draft\", \"published\")\n\n\ndef counts(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Posts and Pages by status, e.g. counts[\"published_posts\"].\"\"\"\n    result = {f\"{status}_{kind}s\": 0 for status in STATUSES for kind in TYPES}\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        for kind in TYPES:\n            for status, number in conn.execute(\n                    f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {kind}s GROUP BY status\"):\n                result[f\"{status}_{kind}s\"] = number\n    return result\n\n\ndef list_items(path: Path, *, kind: str | None = None,\n               status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Posts and Pages in one list, most recently updated first.\n\n    `kind` (\"post\" or \"page\") and `status` (\"draft\" or \"published\") each narrow\n    the list; None means no narrowing. Each row has: kind, id, title, status,\n    author_name (None for a Page with no Author) and updated_at.\n    \"\"\"\n    wanted = [k for k in TYPES if kind in (None, k)]\n    selects = [\n        f\"SELECT '{k}' AS kind, {k}s.id, {k}s.title, {k}s.status, \"\n        f\"users.display_name AS author_name, {k}s.updated_at \"\n        f\"FROM {k}s LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = {k}s.author_id\"\n        + (f\" WHERE {k}s.status = ?\" if status else \"\")\n        for k in wanted\n    ]\n    params = [status] * len(wanted) if status else []\n    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \" UNION ALL \".join(selects) + \" ORDER BY updated_at DESC, kind, id DESC\",\n            params).fetchall()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":36,"oldLines":8,"newStart":36,"newLines":9,"lines":["     \"\"\"","     wanted = [k for k in TYPES if kind in (None, k)]","     selects = [","-        f\"SELECT '{k}' AS kind, {k}s.id, {k}s.title, {k}s.status, \"","-        f\"users.display_name AS author_name, {k}s.updated_at \"","+        f\"SELECT '{k}' AS kind, {k}s.id AS id, {k}s.title AS title, \"","+        f\"{k}s.status AS status, users.display_name AS author_name, \"","+        f\"{k}s.updated_at AS updated_at \"","         f\"FROM {k}s LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = {k}s.author_id\"","         + (f\" WHERE {k}s.status = ?\" if status else \"\")","         for k in wanted"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9428a9a1-5363-488d-892d-9800658835a6","session_id":"ed24a1e3-881f-4be6-a801-a77028a939ce","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yawoppong-krampah/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"47994f02-dcad-41a7-8d5f-7405b25da6b2","version":"2.1.288","gitBranch":"main"}
